name: Rock Island State Park campground dump station
where: Far end of the Main Campground, Rock Island State Park, about 15 miles southwest of Sparta
status_note: The park says the Main Campground, where the dump station is, is open year-round.
access: Tennessee State Parks doesn't say whether non-campers may use it.
water: Not stated for the dump station. Campsites have water hookups.
notes: The tent-only camping area closes Nov 2 – Mar 15 each year, but the Main Campground stays open. The park's brochure routes you from I-40 Exit 288 or I-24 Exit 111. In a hard freeze, call first.
